evidence: Paths: instruction.md:3 names two shipped inputs, 'the six notes in /instructions' and '/assets/seed_data.json'. environment/instructions/ holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui) and environment/assets/ holds exactly seed_data.json (149 bytes). environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets', byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile. No other /assets/... or /instructions/... file path is named in the brief, notes, judge prompts or criteria. Content: seed_data.json parses as {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}. That matches instruction.md:3 ('describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish') and integration.md:7 ('describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'). Solution: solve.sh and server.js never read /assets; server.js only creates tables and inserts on user Save, so the golden starts with an empty library, consistent with snippets: []. Judges: no criterion or prompt depends on seeded records; app_context.md:21 says 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', and persistence criteria create their own uniquely titled snippets (functional/judge.toml:308, 317, 353). The '/assets/index.js' and '/assets/index.css' strings in solution/app/public/index.html:1-2 and vite.config.mjs:5 are the app's own URL paths, not the image's /assets directory, so there is no collision. Counterexample probes: a broken app that ignores the seed gains nothing because nothing is seeded; a conforming app that imports the seed gets an empty list and is not penalised; a conforming app that starts with 'a small example' draft (overview.md:3) is not contradicted by the seed. Limits: this is a static review of the frozen bytes. I did not build the agent image, and the raw evidence index covers scripted golden behaviour only, not the private check-assets-referenced.py / check-fixtures.py executables; the mechanical half was applied by hand and belongs to the deterministic review.
